_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% 12h movement frequency over 7 days defines a textbook coil — calling a direction without a lit breaker is a coin flip, and neither the retail velocity spike (currently 38, needs 60+) nor the leverage wash trigger (funding needs 75+ with dvol at 99) has fired.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — the analyst explicitly calls HOLD with Disbelief as the next phase; the narrative writer implicitly agrees by describing a coil with no breakout trigger but does not commit to a forward phase call.
next_move.confirmed_if: retail_noise_velocity breaks above 60 with btc_momentum_30d sustaining above 60 and funding staying below 65 — genuine retail participation pushes score into Hope band and justifies LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: funding spikes above 75 with dvol_pct_30d remaining at 99 and long_short_pct_30d rising from 1 — leveraged longs in thin liquidity trigger a snap-back to Anxiety or Panic, invalidating the coil-HOLD and requiring CAUTION or REDUCE
